FX.title: [USD/JPY] UP: Carry and Risk-On Flows Keep Pair Above MA20 Despite Overbought RSI
tldr_points: USD/JPY remains above MA20 at 159.62574920654296, confirming short-term bullish structure.
RSI-14 at 71.75136794866748 signals overbought momentum, favoring dip entries over chasing spot.
Risk-on equity flows and fading Iran-war premium support JPY weakness, while oil and geopolitical headlines remain volatility risks.
FX.excerpt: USD/JPY stays bid above MA20 as risk-on and lower safe-haven JPY demand offset RSI overbought risk.
FX.comment: USD/JPY remains above MA20 with supportive risk-on and carry dynamics, but overbought RSI favors dip-entry execution.
